text:
jason: Preflight for tonight's midnight window. Target services: API, runtime, router, console. Planning a staged wave with deploy-bot. Pin matrix below — please ack or call blockers now. Link to release notes: https://internal/release/rls-2026-04-15 :eyes:

sophie: Ack. I'll validate console migration scripts and perf dashboards by 22:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: wave 1 -> runtime v1.4.2 (shard A), wave 2 -> router v2.0.0-canary (10% traffic), wave 3 -> api v3.0.1, wave 4 -> console v3.1.0. Auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR latency P99 increase > 2x baseline for 2m.

maria: Quick note: runtime v1.4.2 includes kernel batching switch. QA confirmed for seq len <=1024 but saw a 2% accuracy regression on a long-context prompt set. I recommend enabling canary-only for runtime wave 1 (shard A) and keep B on v1.4.1 for 30m.

kevin: Agree with maria. Can we pin runtime on shard B to v1.4.1 and have deploy-bot route 10% of shard A to v1.4.2? Avoid broad rollout until we vet outputs.

jason: Good call. Adjusted plan: shard A runtime -> v1.4.2 (10% of overall), shard B -> v1.4.1 stable. Router -> v2.0.0-canary at 5% global first, increase after 15m if no alerts. api & console are low-risk.

deploy-bot: Updated schedule applied. Commands run: 
```
deploybot schedule --wave=1 --service=runtime --variant=v1.4.2 --shard=A --traffic=10%
deploybot schedule --wave=1 --service=runtime --variant=v1.4.1 --shard=B --traffic=90%
```

ops-oncall: If we see a KV cache spike during runtime canary, drain traffic back to v1.4.1 and engage SRE Pager. Also, prepare a manual rollback play: router pin -> previous 1.9.x, runtime rollback -> clear kernel flag and redeploy v1.4.1.

luis: Small ops item — console schema migration requires a quick DB migration lock for ~45s. We should schedule console wave after runtime router stabilization to avoid contention.

sophie: Timeline proposal: 
- 23:55 UTC: quiet window begin, background jobs paused
- 00:00 UTC: wave 1 runtime canary (10%) -> monitor 15m
- 00:20 UTC: router canary (5%) -> monitor 15m
- 00:40 UTC: if clean, ramp runtime to 50% and router to 25%
- 01:10 UTC: api & console waves (console DB lock at 01:15)

jason: Sounds good. One more: pin file for rollout config attached in notes. Also, create a short rollback message for product teams if we hit P0: "We observed quality regression in runtime canary; rolling back runtime to v1.4.1 and routing to stable. No customer data exposed."

maria: I'll run the eval set during the first 10m and post summaries in this thread. If quality delta > 0.03 on our taxonomy metric, we abort ramp.

kevin: FYI I'll hold the console deploy in case DB migration locks cause contention. If anything, we'll defer console to a later window same night.

deploy-bot: wave 1 started at 3305502000: runtime v1.4.2 (shard A) -> 10% applied. Telemetry hooks active.

ops-oncall: Noted. Pager policy: create P0 if 5xx spikes AND customer facing error rate >0.5% for 3m. Otherwise P1.

jason: Thanks everyone — post any immediate observations here. If you don't ack within 30m we'll assume ok and proceed. :thumbsup:

maria: Posting canary eval summary: accuracy delta 0.018 on long-context set, latency P95 +8%, memory use +3%. No 5xx. Recommend proceed to router canary.

sophie: Router canary started at 3305502600: v2.0.0-canary -> 5% global. Monitoring console updated.

kevin: Seeing a small spike in router CPU on a couple of nodes, not yet impacting latency. Keeping watch.

ops-oncall: If CPU >80% on 3+ nodes for 2m, roll router back to 1.9.x.

jason: Because metrics are within thresholds, proceed with ramp plan. Deploy-bot, ramp to runtime 50% and router 25% at next step.

deploy-bot: ramp scheduled and executed at 3305503200: runtime -> 50%, router -> 25%.

maria: Final canary eval after ramp: accuracy delta 0.021, P95 latency +9%, quality alerts unchanged. No 5xx. I greenlight api & console waves.

luis: Starting console DB lock at 3305503800 (expected ~45s).

ops-oncall: All green. No rollbacks triggered.

jason: Closing loop: release notes updated with final pins and canary outcomes. I'll file the post-release summary tomorrow AM with perf and cost delta. Great job. :tada:
